title: Concrete Driveways
shortDescription: Durable driveways built for Brantford winters — reinforced with rebar or wire mesh, properly graded, and finished in broom, exposed aggregate, or stamped patterns.
fullDescription: Your driveway is the first thing people see and the surface that takes the most abuse. We design and pour high-strength concrete driveways that resist cracking, shifting, and salt damage. Every pour includes a compacted granular base, reinforced construction, and engineered control joints. Choose from a classic broom finish, premium exposed aggregate, or decorative stamped borders — all designed to outlast Ontario's freeze-thaw cycles.
features: Standard Broom Finish for non-slip safety and longevity
Exposed Aggregate for premium pebbled look and traction
Stamped Borders for a decorative touch around standard driveways
Widenings & Extensions for extra parking
Reinforced bases for heavy load support
Proper drainage planning to prevent water pooling

title: Patios & Walkways
shortDescription: Custom outdoor living spaces and walkways — stamped concrete, slip-resistant finishes, and designs that flow naturally with your landscape.
fullDescription: Extend your living space outdoors with a custom concrete patio or walkway. We design functional, beautiful hardscapes to fit your landscape exactly. Stamped concrete can mimic stone, brick, or wood at a fraction of the cost. Pool decks get slip-resistant finishes for safety, and fire pit pads are poured to handle heavy loads and high heat.
features: Custom shapes including curves, kidneys, and geometric designs
Stamped concrete mimicking slate, flagstone, or timber
Slip-resistant finishes for pool decks and paths
Custom curves and layout designs
Fire pit pads and dedicated heavy-duty areas
Properly graded away from the house foundation

title: Walkways, Steps & Porches
shortDescription: Safe, welcoming entrances — level, code-compliant concrete steps and walkways that eliminate trip hazards and boost curb appeal.
fullDescription: Crumbling steps and uneven walkways are a major trip hazard. We replace old, dangerous paths with smooth, level, and code-compliant concrete. From grand front entryways to side paths connecting your front and back yards, every project is reinforced to prevent shifting and finished to match your home's style.
features: Front entryways for curb appeal boost
Side walkways for a clean, mud-free path
Reinforced concrete steps that won't rot or shift
Porch slabs and landings
Custom decorative finishes available
Code-compliant construction throughout

title: Stamped & Decorative Concrete
shortDescription: High-end aesthetics with concrete durability — Ashlar Slate, Cobblestone, Roman Brick, and Wood Plank patterns with integral color and sealers.
fullDescription: Stamped concrete is an art form. We use specialized mats and coloring hardeners to texture the wet concrete, mimicking natural materials like stone, brick, and wood — at a fraction of the cost. Integral colors are mixed in, and release agents create antique, two-tone effects. Finished with high-gloss or matte sealers to pop the color and protect the surface for decades.
features: Ashlar Slate, Cobblestone, Roman Brick, Wood Plank patterns
Integral colors mixed directly into the concrete
Release agents for antique and two-tone effects
High-gloss or matte sealers for UV protection
Color restoration on existing stamped concrete
Custom pattern combinations available

title: Concrete Sealing & Maintenance
shortDescription: Professional sealing against freeze-thaw cycles, road salt, and UV rays — high-grade penetrating and acrylic sealers that restore color and prevent damage.
fullDescription: Protect your investment from Brantford's harsh freeze-thaw cycles, salt, and UV rays. Our professional sealing services lock in color and prevent moisture penetration. We use high-grade penetrating and acrylic sealers that restore the color vibrancy of old stamped concrete, prevent oil stains, and stop salt damage before it starts.
features: High-grade penetrating and acrylic sealers
Restores color vibrancy to old stamped concrete
Prevents oil stains and salt damage
Annual and multi-year maintenance plans
Safe for children, pets, and the environment
Extends concrete lifespan by 10+ years

title: Concrete Repair & Resurfacing
shortDescription: Restore structurally sound concrete without a full tear-out — crack filling, polymer overlay resurfacing, and leveling of uneven slabs.
fullDescription: Don't let cracks or spalling ruin your concrete. If your slab is structurally sound, you might not need a full replacement. Our repair services restore structural strength and appearance at a fraction of the cost. We route and seal cracks to prevent water infiltration, apply polymer-modified overlays to worn surfaces, and level uneven slabs to eliminate trip hazards.
features: Expert crack routing and filling
Polymer-modified overlay resurfacing
Leveling uneven slabs (trip hazard removal)
Parging for crumbling foundation walls
Structural assessment before any work begins
Color-matched repairs for seamless results
